title: Texas death row convictions partly based on hypnotic regression

tellings.quote: two guys on death row right now in Texas

plain: Two men are on death row in Texas right now whose convictions rested partly on hypnotic regression, a technique that uses hypnosis to recover supposedly buried memories. Michels tells this himself, as something he learned from John Blitch, a scientist with DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency, who says he was abducted by an alien. It comes up because hypnosis is also used to recover abduction memories, so it raises how much weight such memories can bear.
